title: Beamscan Spectrum
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/Beamscan_Spectrum.md
text: Beamscan 空间谱估计器，输入 1 路、输出 2 路；按 {Geometry} 指定阵列几何结构；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating frequency (Hz)} 指定系统工作频率 3e8、{Number of bits in phase shifters} 指定相移量化位数、{Forward-backward averaging} 启用前向-后向平均、{Azimuth scan angles (deg)} 指定方位方向扫描角度、{Elevation scan angles (deg)} 指定俯仰方向扫描角度、{Enable DOA output} 指定通过输出端口输出到达方向、{Number of signals} 指定预期到达信号数、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted、{Specify sensor array as} 指定阵列的方法 Array、{Expression} 用于创建阵列的 MATLAB 表达式 Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System、{Number of elements} 指定阵列阵元数 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA、{Element spacing (m)} 指定阵列阵元间距 0.5 for ULA arrays、{Array axis} 指定 ULA 的线性轴方向、{Array size} 指定 URA 阵列的维度、{Element lattice} 指定 URA 阵元位置的格点、{Array normal} 指定阵列法线方向 x for URA arrays or z for UCA、{Radius of UCA (m)} 指定 UCA 阵列半径、{Element positions (m)} 指定共形阵列阵元的位置、{Element normals (deg)} 指定共形阵列阵元法向量方向、{Taper} 指定阵列阵元渐削，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 接收信号 M -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Beamscan 二维空间谱 non-negative real-valued P -by- Q matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 到达方向 non-negative, real-valued 2-by- L matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Operating frequency (Hz)
params.values: 系统工作频率 3e8 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Number of bits in phase shifters
params.values: 相移量化位数 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Forward-backward averaging
params.values: 启用前向-后向平均 off (default) | on

params.name: Azimuth scan angles (deg)
params.values: 方位方向扫描角度 -180:180 (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Elevation scan angles (deg)
params.values: 俯仰方向扫描角度 -90:90 (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Enable DOA output
params.values: 通过输出端口输出到达方向 off (default) | on

params.name: Number of signals
params.values: 预期到达信号数 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Specify sensor array as
params.values: 指定阵列的方法 Array (no subarrays) (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Expression
params.values: 用于创建阵列的 MATLAB 表达式 Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System object

params.name: Geometry
params.values: 阵列几何结构 ULA (default) | URA | UCA | Conformal Array

params.name: Number of elements
params.values: 阵列阵元数 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA arrays (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Element spacing (m)
params.values: 阵列阵元间距 0.5 for ULA arrays and [0.5,0.5] for URA arrays (default) | positive scalar for ULA or URA arrays | 2-element vector of positive values for URA arrays

params.name: Array axis
params.values: ULA 的线性轴方向 y (default) | x | z

params.name: Array size
params.values: URA 阵列的维度 [2,2] (default) | positive integer | 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Element lattice
params.values: URA 阵元位置的格点 Rectangular (default) | Triangular

params.name: Array normal
params.values: 阵列法线方向 x for URA arrays or z for UCA arrays (default) | y

params.name: Radius of UCA (m)
params.values: UCA 阵列半径 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Element positions (m)
params.values: 共形阵列阵元的位置 [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by- N matrix of real values

params.name: Element normals (deg)
params.values: 共形阵列阵元法向量方向 [0;0] | 2-by-1 column vector | 2-by- N matrix

params.name: Taper
params.values: 阵列阵元渐削 1 (default) | complex scalar | complex-valued row vector
